sources.title: DAS Solar, UNSW build tunnel back-contact solar cell with 27% efficiency, lower silver content

title: Mandatory utility fees distort price signals for rooftop solar in the US

sources.title: Mandatory utility fees distort price signals for rooftop solar in the US
sources.excerpt: Regulators in 27 U.S. states are shifting residential electricity pricing toward higher fixed monthly charges and lower usage-based rates, weakening the economics of rooftop solar and home battery systems. sources.title: New metric assesses innovation readiness in agrivoltaics
sources.excerpt: A study from Türkiye has introduced the Agrivoltaic Innovation Index (AII), a composite scientometric tool designed to assess innovation readiness in agrivoltaics beyond traditional publication and citation metrics.
